scope: Actual primary and standalone PAPER exit protection after partials, uncapped extreme tails and preservation of original whole-trade net valuation peaks. No active run, model or learned policy activation.
quality_grain: One original 0.1 SOL PAPER buy; one exact remaining raw quantity and cash/fee generation. Whole-trade estimated net return and remaining-leg return are separate measures, not interchangeable percentages.

findings.defect: The total-profit protection floor jumped to 150 percent when the remaining-leg peak reached 300 percent, even when that total profit had never been earned after earlier partials.
findings.evidence: An isolated actual check_exit_conditions test returned a full-close action before the fix. A 10 USD entry with 250 units sold at +25 percent, 250 at +50 percent, 200 at +100 percent and 150 at +300 percent realizes 16.875 USD. The remaining 150/1000 units quote 6 USD at +300 percent, making total gross profit 128.75 percent and estimated total net profit 128.6 percent under the test's frozen fees. The legacy total-profit floor was 150 percent.
findings.remediation: Use independently checked current and original whole-trade net peak receipts. For an activated frozen PAPER runner policy, cap the existing total-profit floor by its drawdown fraction applied to the actually observed whole-trade net wealth. Preserve remaining-leg trailing, stop/loss, liquidity and timeout protections.

findings.defect: Binary floating-point conversion of exact quote cash could put a mathematically exact partial or trailing boundary a few machine-precision units on the wrong side.
findings.evidence: The actual six-partial ladder fixture missed the +1000 percent step and an exact 20 percent cash drawdown did not trigger its inclusive protection boundary. Meaningfully lower partial returns and a quote one lamport above the trailing boundary are covered separately.
findings.remediation: Inclusive equality uses rel_tol=1e-12 and abs_tol=1e-10 in the shared partial-ladder trigger and dynamic runner floor, without clipping returns or widening economically meaningful thresholds.

implemented: Detached immutable PaperCashProtection retains only checked original current and whole-net-peak receipts with public frozen entry inputs. Unknown, expired, conflicting or forged contexts remain unknown, not zero, spot valuation or stored SQL total.

Portfolio observations atomically persist a distinct cash_total_peak_mark from the first checked whole-net observation, including negative estimates. A higher remaining-leg return or smaller partial-fill quote never manufactures a whole-trade peak.

Original quantity/realized cash/estimated fees and quote/FX clocks are revalidated at actual policy consumption. SQL matching requires the original buy identity and current exact financial generation. No SQL schema migration or operator data rewrite is needed.
Actual main exit wrapper and standalone monitor consume the checked context; live and legacy callers keep their existing policy rather than being retrospectively cash-certified.

Original whole-net peak survives partials and terminal archive without renewing its clock or replacing its quantity with the later remaining quantity. Rewound, forged, later or lower-than-current peak receipts are rejected.

Three isolated actual six-partial PAPER executions retain the remaining tail through extreme cash returns, hold a small retrace and close on the frozen cash drawdown. The close re-quotes its actual quantity and archived estimated net cash reconciles independently. No floor-price fill is fabricated.
